description: This is a test source file for the 'FeaturesRoute' in the 'org.eclipse.ditto' project. It contains unit tests for various HTTP endpoints related to features, including CRUD operations on features, feature definitions, properties, and inbox messages, using the Akka HTTP testkit and JUnit framework.
